findings.title: Hardcoded Secret Key
findings.description: SECRET_KEY is hardcoded in source code. This exposes credentials if code is committed to version control.
findings.recommendation: Move SECRET_KEY to environment variable or config file.

findings.title: Missing Input Length Validation
findings.description: Username and password inputs are not validated for length or format. Could lead to DoS via excessively long inputs.
findings.recommendation: Add input validation for username/password length and format.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting on Login Endpoint
findings.description: Login endpoint has no rate limiting. Vulnerable to brute-force password attacks.
findings.recommendation: Add Flask-Limiter to rate-limit login attempts.

findings.title: Debug Mode Enabled in Production
findings.description: app.run(debug=True) should not be used in production environments. Enables debugger and auto-reloader, leaking stack traces.
findings.recommendation: Disable debug mode in production deployments.
